content.title: Native U, whole-bucket and finite structural readback witnesses checked
content.text:
Checked code 61836d8e4ad406e3fddd3f3f6676efb56fe75776 follows e5494cf84f49b538eb3f8c41de1b12a1df5a2983. Native-U bridge: the SAME accepted source/cold build derives the original stored U language, then TypeIn membership at its actual native handle, retained through past growth/issued history. No native-membership, model or future-success provider. This does not identify arbitrary narrowed pending domains with U.

The actual parked whole-bucket producer now constructs ONE assignment satisfying EVERY actual removed obligation when EVERY represented path is [1] or [2], retaining actual clear/full slot/indexed duplicates and before/checked/parked/restarted UF. This explicit shape restriction excludes terminal/deeper paths. No all-source shape theorem is assumed.

New structural evaluator extends ANY UF-compatible pending choices under Safe+Stratified. ONE finite assignment satisfies ALL stored expanded equations and UF while preserving every pending slot. The same actual native root readback and singleton endpoint precede those choices. rootPartial_complete_pending_choices constructs its finite structural completion; no pending-domain/scs emptiness or full Satisfies is required. Original full-model headers remain byte-exact compatibility wrappers; long producers are shared.

Safe+PendingReferences derives agreement for every actual raw suspended target through its live canonical pending root, including eliminated aliases. Stored bucket Holds transfers under the SAME extension. The actual arrow-bucket composition therefore proves BEFORE UF + ALL stored fragment equations + the ENTIRE actually removed bucket + TypeIn at every pending slot under ONE assignment. It retains actual clear receipts but does NOT copy the base assignment later-forest facts onto the extension.

Biggest gap remains ONE finite accepted completion of the SAME original emitted root under ONE compatible assignment for ALL actual narrowed domains, residuals, arbitrary retained/proper paths and EVERY historical removed obligation on its actual branch. Structural readback now genuinely constructs rho; the full Satisfies/original-acceptance/all-history target is still SPECIFICATION ONLY. Post-clear PendingReferences cannot recover a removed RHS; use the genuine pre-clear receipt. Independent local models cannot be combined by choice.

DONE-domain audit: recursiveBoundary admits BOTH MU AND UNION. Actual only-U atoms plus existing Mu classifier yield FULL original U value/body equality; lookup_encode yields exact handle. Missing: only-U propagation for EVERY actual retained pending slot through warm source/native/projection/merge/restoration, then explicit UNION classification/collapse/productivity. Cold component native-result atoms are checked local progress, not all-slot coverage. Program/Type roles/annotations do not supply this. No-handle buckets and source-no-Mu cases also remain. No accepted-source counterexample or Haskell bug is inferred.

Original real shared source preparation/scanner, generated-Type closed/mixed closure at ALL supplied fuels and 66-probe source-resource cases remain checked. Whole row-prefix/SourceTask induction and all-fuel/all-outcome emitted history remain OPEN; original four targets/prepared16/noStop/earlier emissions after stop/fuels/budgets remain. Full typing/depth adequacy/completeness, BOTH defaultLPO/preprocessing language directions, stream order/multiplicity/lazy demand, exact node-count classes, counts/weights/training, BOTH rank inverses, host bounds and compiled Haskell correspondence remain in scope.

All5 final public gates PASS: 96,664 aggregate checks;210 explicit reports=208 standard+2 axiom-free;6,006 source modules/5,005 direct imports. Unchanged source/config pins;8GiB/zero swap/one Lean thread/no heartbeat increase;only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound. Header comparison verifies four old public headers and unchanged entire expandPartial_complete. Parser-failed probe-import check retained; unchanged candidate passed after probe-only correction. No Haskell/Cabal/tests/Liquid changes or new Haskell defect/fix. Removed3,851,656 bytes of terminal private objects from9 exact dirs;durable sources/probes/logs and public .lake retained. Readable /tmp about455MB;primary18 percent. Main e53852064d3e unchanged/already ancestor. Compact immutable checkpoint follows; full goal ACTIVE.
